objectives.description: Simulated skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md removal acceptance test (Testing & Validation explicit requirement)
objectives.note: Found a real coupling: test-loop-guard-budget-override.sh invokes the out-of-scope sibling suite test-session-runtime-files.sh (flat scripts/, not scripts/tests/**, so out of this plan's Non-Goals edit boundary), whose own preflight hard-requires the hard file (a known, separately-tracked limitation of that sibling, not a regression from this work). Fixed with a narrow, specifically-matched carve-out in test-loop-guard-budget-override.sh's own nested-suite invocation, downgrading only that exact error pair to informational so a genuine Case 3 regression would still fail loudly. Confirmed all seven files pass both with the hard file present and with it temporarily renamed away, then restored.

approaches_tried.approach: test-handoff-dispatch-identity.sh: rely on existing pattern-match assertions alone to detect an append_detected_defect rename
approaches_tried.reason: Existing assertions only grep for their own expected substring's presence in stderr, never for absence of unrelated noise like a bash 'command not found' error, so a rename regression passed silently. Fixed by adding an explicit negative assertion.

deviations.description: Additional acceptance-test item performed and fixed, beyond the phase's originally-enumerated task bullets
deviations.reason: Testing & Validation explicitly requires 'All seven files pass both with skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md still on disk and with it removed' as the actual acceptance condition for the dependent deletion task. Running this simulation surfaced a real, previously-undiscovered coupling that would have silently broken the sibling deletion task's acceptance gate. Fixed within scope (the fix lives in one of the seven target files) without touching the out-of-scope sibling suite, honoring the plan's Non-Goals boundary.
